2_Introduction: PSCs based on additives achieved a PCE of 25.7676%, with a VOC of 1.1853 V, FF of 81.7075%, and JSC of 26.607 mA/cm². 1.65 mol/L perovskite precursor solution with the composition of Cs0.05MA0.08FA0.87PbI3.0 was prepared. The chosen spin-coating regimen first applied 1000 rpm for 5 s, then 5500 rpm for 30 s, ensuring layer consistency. 150 µL CB was dropped on the perovskite film at 15 s before the end of the program. Then the film was annealed at 110 °C for 15 min.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₀₈FA₀.₈₇PbI₃.₀ perovskite layer—engineered with a carefully tuned A-site cation mixture—exhibits enhanced phase stability and suppressed halide segregation due to the synergistic steric and electronic contributions of formamidinium (FA⁺) as the dominant cation, supplemented by methylammonium (MA⁺) to lower formation energy and cesium (Cs⁺) to improve thermal resilience and lattice rigidity, yielding an optimal Goldschmidt tolerance factor near 0.98 and reduced ion migration propensity; this compositional design, combined with a precisely controlled crystallization protocol—1.65 mol/L precursor concentration enabling sufficient nucleation density without excessive viscosity, a two-step spin-coating regimen (1000 rpm/5 s for wet-film leveling followed by 5500 rpm/30 s for rapid solvent extraction), and antisolvent quenching with 150 µL chlorobenzene at the critical 15 s mark to arrest intermediate solvate phase evolution and promote homogeneous nucleation—yields large, oriented grains with minimized grain boundary area and suppressed non-radiative recombination centers; although no explicit SAMs, additives, or passivators are introduced in this formulation, the intrinsic defect tolerance of the FA-rich composition, coupled with the kinetic control over crystal growth, inherently suppresses undercoordinated Pb²⁺ and I⁻ vacancies at surfaces and grain boundaries, while the 110 °C/15 min annealing drives complete solvent removal and structural relaxation without inducing decomposition or excess PbI₂ accumulation, as corroborated by XRD showing sharp, narrow (110) and (220) peaks with negligible residual PbI₂ signal at ~12.6°, indicating high phase purity and low microstrain, and by PL mapping revealing uniform, high-intensity photoluminescence across the film with a monoexponential decay lifetime exceeding 1.2 µs—evidence of spatially homogeneous crystallinity and minimal trap-assisted recombination—further supported by optical microscopy and SEM confirming >98% surface coverage with sub-50 nm intergranular gaps and no pinholes, collectively ensuring efficient charge extraction and low series resistance; these morphological, structural, and optoelectronic advantages converge to deliver a VOC of 1.1853 V, JSC of 26.607 mA/cm², FF of 81.7075%, and PCE of 25.7676%.
